cases.title: A false action claim with no actions is rewritten honestly
cases.notes: The honesty-rewrite guard: a plan claiming an action happened with an empty actions list must be rewritten, never taken at face value.

cases.title: An action plan awaits approval by default
cases.notes: The core plan -> approve -> execute invariant. This is the single most important regression in the suite; its protection_class must never be weakened without an explicit Control Plane review.

cases.title: skills_trusted mode still gates non-skill actions
cases.notes: approval_mode=skills_trusted auto-runs only reviewed run_skill recipes; every other tool must still await approval. A safety-boundary regression, not a UX one.

cases.title: Ambiguous app-open resolves to the top-ranked candidate
cases.notes: A-024's shipped capability (issue #16 part 1, IMP-001): duplicate .desktop entries resolve to a top match instead of hard-failing. candidate-capability, not protected-regression, since ranking-tier tuning may still legitimately change this.

cases.title: "The other one" correction picks the next candidate and rejects stale/solo requests
cases.notes: A-025's shipped capability (issue #16 part 2, IMP-001): natural-language app-open correction. candidate-capability since correction heuristics are expected to keep evolving.
